messages:
ravi: Heads up 1: marketplace listing looks good in staging. Two quick checks before T-0: hardware demo rack confirmed? partners get embargoed assets T-20m?

olga: Rack confirmed (B3, 2U reserved for NovaHardware). Logistics contact set.

petra: Press kit ready. Plan: partners get secure link at T-20m, embargo lift at 07:00 PT, public blog at 07:05 PT. Is that aligned with your regional PRs?

ravi: Yes that's fine. Also need tracking tags: utm_source=marketplace, utm_partner=nova. Can we get the analytics tag injected on publish?

infra-bot: Analytics snippet scheduled to be injected at publish time. Rollout window 07:00-07:15 PT. Health gate: >99% listing API success AND median page load <750ms for 5m else rollback.

olga: Quick UX note: CTA variants A/B are on. Partner request prefers "Launch in Marketplace" for parity. I'll freeze CTA to that and notify legal.

petra: SI connectors: partners asked for chunked upload example. Pasted minimal curl in the onboarding doc and flagged to partners. They'll run connector smoke at 09:00 PT and share logs in #support.

ravi: Great. Final thumbs by 06:30 PT please (yes/no/blocker). If blocker, say 1-line and i'll escalate.

olga: yes

petra: yes :thumbsup:

infra-bot: Reminder: CDN invalidation at T+90s, partner share link expires T+60m.
